wiki.title: Chris Deluzio
wiki.extract: Christopher Raphael Deluzio (born July 13, 1984) is an American politician, attorney, and former U.S. Navy officer. A progressive Democrat, he serves as the U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 17th congressional district since 2023. The district encompasses most of the northwestern suburbs and exurbs of Pittsburgh, and includes the entirety of Beaver County.
